idea-plugin.name: API Radar
idea-plugin.description:
API Radar

Zero-intrusion capture of third-party HTTP requests/responses in your Java project, without adding a single line of logging or breakpoint.

API Radar attaches a lightweight Java Agent to your running JVM, intercepts the supported HTTP clients via ByteBuddy, and streams every request/response (method, URL, headers, body, duration, status code, error) to an IDE Tool Window in real time.

Supported HTTP clients

  • Spring RestTemplate
  • Apache HttpClient 4 / 5
  • OkHttp (roadmap)
  • JDK HttpClient (Java 11+) (roadmap)
  • Spring WebClient (roadmap)
  • Feign (roadmap)

How it works

  1. Start your Java application (on JDK 21+ add -Djdk.attach.allowAttachSelf=true).
  2. Run Tools → Attach API Radar and pick the target process.
  3. Open the API Radar tool window at the bottom; events appear live as your code hits external APIs.

Privacy & Security

  • All captured data stays on your local machine. Nothing is uploaded to any remote server.
  • The plugin and the Agent communicate over a local TCP port (loopback only).
  • You can pause capture, set URL include/exclude globs, and cap body sizes from the settings page.
  • Source code: GitHub

  • Attach a Java Agent to a running JVM and capture Spring RestTemplate and Apache HttpClient 4/5 traffic.
